notes: Refined existing stories for completeness and contract clarity; no new IDs created.

change_log.value: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, optional travel params including origin and mode) and normalized output schema including title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations, and optional travel distance/duration fields.
change_log.note: Clarify travel parameters and output contract

change_log.value: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, including pagination/limit handling, retry/error handling, and normalization of trial data fields (title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations) with graceful handling of missing/partial fields.

stories.title: Define Clinical Trial Search Input and Output Schema
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, optional travel params including origin and mode) and normalized output schema including title, phase, summary, eligibility, locations, and optional travel distance/duration fields.

stories.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic

stories.title: Expose Clinical Trial Search via Evaluate Care Facade

stories.title: Add Travel Distance and Duration Enrichment
